# Remember to Die — Skipstone Studios

> Tactical dice combat roguelike. Coming September 26th. Wishlist on Steam.

Remember to Die is an indie roguelike game by Skipstone Studios (New Zealand) where death is a mechanic, not a failure state. Every run teaches you something new.

## Core Gameplay

- 32 unique dice with distinct combat abilities
- 117 mementos that modify your run and playstyle
- Turn-based tactical combat with deep build variety
- Permadeath roguelike structure — every run is different
- Rich narrative threading through each playthrough

## About Skipstone Studios

Solo indie dev studio based in New Zealand. Building Remember to Die with a focus on replayability, narrative depth, and dark atmospheric aesthetics.

Contact: alex@skipstone.co.nz
